info.title: Nutrikit API
info.description: Food search, nutrient breakdowns, meal logging from text/voice/photos, barcode and nutrition-label scanning, and meal plans. Data: USDA FoodData Central (public domain) and Open Food Facts (ODbL). Usage is metered in tokens; AI-assisted calls add 1 token per 1,000 model tokens.

bearer.description: Secret API key `nk_...` (also accepted as X-Api-Key) or an access token `nkat_...` from POST /v1/auth/token

missingFrom.description: Totals only: how many of the summed foods had no value for this nutrient, so the amount is a lower bound. Absent when every food had one.

match.description: How the results matched; absent when nothing matched

didYouMean.description: Set when the query as typed matched no food well: the respelled query these results are for
The phrase respelled, when only the respelling matches a food ("1 cup panner" -> "1 cup paneer")

note.description: Why a phrase that matched a food was still not logged, e.g. a plate of a dry, uncooked staple

basis.description: What per100g is per: liquids are labelled per 100 ml

issues.description: Why the label values were withheld (they contradict each other); empty when they passed the checks

local.description: Served from the local Open Food Facts export rather than the live API

barcodes.description: Search results only: every barcode this product is sold under (same name, brand and label values), the shown one first

get.description: For load balancers and uptime monitors. 503 names the failing checks. `/v1/health` is the liveness check and never touches the database.

post.description: Costs 5 token(s) + AI usage. Requires an AI provider. General nutrition guidance, not medical advice: medical, medication and other out-of-scope questions come back with `declined: true`. Pass `context` (goals, preferences, today's log) to tailor the answer; it is treated as data, not instructions.

post.description: Free. Send your secret API key as the bearer credential; receive an `nkat_` token valid for 1 hour. Give access tokens to browsers and mobile apps instead of the secret key. Access tokens cannot mint new tokens.
